nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Sustainable industry|Green technologies_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How can optimal investment in green technologies help reduce carbon emissions in the textile industry's supply chain?
nodes.answer: Optimal investment in green technologies can help reduce carbon emissions in the textile industry's supply chain by adopting cleaner production methods at the supplier and manufacturer stages, as shown in studies by Shen and Li (2019) and De Oliveira NATO et al. (2019).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Sustainable industry|Green technologies_qna_002
nodes.label: Ethics and Regulation
nodes.question: What are the benefits of implementing strict regulations for the cap-and-trade system on manufacturers investing in green technology?
nodes.answer: By implementing strict regulations, manufacturers are encouraged to invest in green technology to minimize emissions, ultimately reducing environmental impact and improving the greenness of goods.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Sustainable industry|Green technologies_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: How can green technology help control carbon emissions in manufacturing?
nodes.answer: Green technology can control carbon emissions in manufacturing by investing in sustainable practices, such as renewable energy sources, energy-efficient technologies, and carbon pricing models to incentivize lower emissions.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What does the study evaluate regarding technological innovation?
nodes.answer: The study evaluates the contribution of technological innovation, particularly green technologies, in mitigating environmental impacts and accelerating clean energy sources.
nodes.paragraph: The transforma- tion of the educational landscape necessitates collaborative endeavors [ 5]. Governments, international organizations, private entities, and civil society must engage in collaborative efforts to formulate policies, secure adequate Vol. :(123456789)Discover Sustainability (2025) 6:136 I https://doi.org/10.1007/s43621-25-853-2 Research 4. Evaluate the contribution of technological innovation, mainly green technologies, in mitigating environmental impacts and accelerating clean energy sources. Environmental sustainability remains a pressing challenge for resource-rich nations as they grapple with balanc - ing economic growth and ecological preservation. This study provides an innovative perspective on this challenge by examining the interplay of natural resource rents, education, financial inclusion, and technological innovation within Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 7 and 13. While prior research has extensively explored these factors in isolation, this study uniquely integrates them to analyze their collective influence on sustainability outcomes. Specifically, it identi- fies the dynamics between these variables and their dual implications for environmental degradation and sustainable energy practices. The objectives of this research are twofold. First, it seeks to delineate the complex interactions between natural resource income and CO2 emissions, thereby unraveling the environmental consequences of resource dependency.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the influence of technology differences on corporate environmental patents according to a resource-based versus an institutional view of green innovations?
nodes.answer: Technology differences have varying impacts on corporate environmental patents, with the resource-based view emphasizing internal capabilities and the institutional view focusing on external factors and regulations influencing green innovations in companies.
